visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static wide shot of a massive brown landslide on a steep green mountain. A yellow excavator is perched precariously on the slope, its mechanical arm actively digging and moving dark soil to stabilize the area. The background features lush green temperate forests under a grey, overcast sky. (2) The scene transitions to a lower perspective on the paved mountain road. A group of roughly seven people in casual outdoor jackets stand near a badly crumpled metal guardrail, looking down at the damaged slope. Several motorcycles and a white SUV are parked along the asphalt road. (3) A drone or high-angle perspective shows the sheer scale of the earth displacement, looking up the mountain where the forest has been stripped away. The yellow excavator continues its work, appearing small against the massive scar. The lighting is flat and natural, highlighting the textures of the soil. (4) At the bottom of the frame, a large red regulatory sign is permanently displayed, detailing road control dates, times, and specific rules in clear white and black Traditional Chinese characters. The sign takes up the bottom third of the frame throughout the entire duration.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a traffic update and visual documentation regarding a landslide repair project on the Tai 7A highway in Taiwan. It clearly displays both the scale of the damage and the official traffic control schedule for travelers.
